text.tspan: Static Site: The Evans Carlson Society (gh-pages)
Clicking on the star changes the "The Evans Carlson
Society" text into "Choose Theme" and "Paper · Night".
The night theme automatically darkens overly bright images.
The home.articles.about link points to the page on the right, the homepage:
the same header as within an article, just an article scroller with About Us
The website is adaptive and mr. E.C. and the star choose a reasonable spacing.
They scroll away totally normally, there is no return to top button.

tspan.tspan: A novel broad-front antiwar coalition based in

text.tspan: Text is such that there is a minimum of 30em per row (600px wide screen) and 40em per row (1200px wide screen),
but also scaled vertically as to fit at least 16 lines of text, or 32 on a large screen. Font choice and formatting is not final.
Prioritize top 80% of objective readability metrics, but in the stylistic margin (20%) prefer a clean and formal appearance
that resembles a newspaper. Ensure that aspects such as line spacing and column width are optimized compared
to the numbers given, and that they give a sense of deeply informative text that people will take the time to read.
This is a static site, but have a .EPUB download button.

text.tspan: Avoid using animations entirely. The website should
Article header images should be prescaled
both to preview and full size, but simply
with JPEG for fallback, and ~20KiB for the rest.
The entire page should be less than 100KiB.
Ensure we pass the 14KiB TCP slow start limit;
log image dimensions in the static site build tool
and use them as part of the generated site to
A content editor accessed through a secret, password
protected web portal allows us to modify the articles
that exist in the git repo and rebuild the gh-pages.
This will be built via netlify unless you have a simpler
